_readme: Knowledge for the Help assistant (main.js). Written ONLY from what the home page says. The assistant matches a visitor's words against 'keywords' (whole words or phrases) and shows 'answer'; if nothing matches well it says so and offers phone, email or a message. Never add a fact here that isn't on the site. 'answer' may hold simple HTML links. 'suggest' entries become the tap-to-ask chips (4-6).

entries.answer: Island Breeze serves adults aged 55 and older in Markham. If you're not sure whether a program is right for you or someone you care for, just call or email and we'll talk it through.
Joining starts with a friendly conversation. Call 416-319-7763 or email islandbreezeseniors@<wbr>gmail.com and we'll talk you through it. You can also send us a message and ask for a call back.
Costs can vary by activity. Please call or email us to ask about the activity you're interested in.

entries.q: Can my caregiver come with me?
entries.answer: Our mission includes older adults and their caregivers. Please call or email to talk about coming together, so we can plan the visit with you.
Our schedule changes through the year, so we don't list times here. Please call or email for this month's activities and times.

entries.q: Is it accessible? Is there transportation?
entries.answer: Please call or email before your visit so we can talk through access, mobility needs and how you'll get there.

We're at Hagerman Corners Community Homes, 4460 14th Avenue, Markham, Ontario. Please call or email before your first visit so we can tell you where to meet. Get directions on Google Maps (opens in a new tab).

Recent activities include a crochet circle, arts and crafts, pottery with Markham Museum, game night with dominoes, a Christmas dinner, and outings like the Markham Museum, a Carefirst tea party and the Carefirst Health Fair. Some run regularly and some are one-time events, so please call or email to hear what's on this month. See all activities.

In 2026, Island Breeze ran Cultural Arts for Holistic Healing, a workshop series for seniors in South Markham funded by United Way Greater Toronto. From January to July, members tried drumming, poetry for healing grief, Afro-Peruvian dance, art clay, a health and wellness day with blood pressure checks, Zumba and merengue, and a closing fashion show and lunch. Laughter Yoga was part of the series too. Please call or email to ask what's coming up next.
Call 416-319-7763 or email islandbreezeseniors@gmail.com. You can also find us on Facebook (opens in a new tab) and Instagram (opens in a new tab).

Island Breeze Seniors Day Program is a federal not-for-profit, incorporated in 2018 and run by a volunteer board with help from volunteers and community facilitators. Our roots are Caribbean, and so is our welcome. Our mission: supporting seniors' well-being through advocacy and resources.
